messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 23):
"""
premium)-furnish the rate table, if any 8.23 Gross premium- furnish the rate table, if any S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 8.24 Expected loss ratio (for the product) -to be furnished for each plan offered within the product separately 8.25 Age-wise loss ratio- to be furnished for each option or plan offered within the product separately S.No Age Loss ratio 8.26 Sum insured-wise- loss ratio to be furnished for each option or plan offered within the product separately S.No SA Loss ratio 8.27 Age and sum insured wise loss ratio - to be furnished for each option or plan separately Table given below (SI band and age bands shall be increased / decreased depending on the minimum and maximum SI / Age offered) S.NO SI/Age bands 25000 50000 100000 150000 200000 1 >=0<=2 2 >=3<=15 3 >=16<=25 4 >=26<=30 5 >=31<=35 6 >=36<=40 7 >=41<=45 8 >=46<=50 9 >=51<=55 10 >=56<=60
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What specific loss ratio information must an insurer furnish for each plan offered within a product?","answer":"An insurer must provide the expected loss ratio for each plan, the age-wise loss ratio for each option or plan, the sum insured-wise loss ratio for each option or plan, and the age and sum insured-wise loss ratio for each option or plan.","facts":["Expected loss ratio (for the product) -to be furnished for each plan offered within the product separately","Age-wise loss ratio- to be furnished for each option or plan offered within the product separately","Sum insured-wise- loss ratio to be furnished for each option or plan offered within the product separately","Age and sum insured wise loss ratio - to be furnished for each option or plan separately"]},{"question":"What are the age and sum insured bands that insurers should use when reporting age and sum insured-wise loss ratios?","answer":"Insurers should use the following bands: SI/Age bands 25000, 50000, 100000, 150000, 200000 with age ranges 0-2, 3-15, 16-25, 26-30, 31-35, 36-40, 41-45, 46-50, 51-55, and 56-60 years.","facts":["SI/Age bands 25000 50000 100000 150000 200000","1 >=0<=2","2 >=3<=15","3 >=16<=25","4 >=26<=30","5 >=31<=35","6 >=36<=40","7 >=41<=45","8 >=46<=50","9 >=51<=55","10 >=56<=60"]}]}
